details.reason: DANDI:000003 YutaMouse session has BehavioralEvents/Epochs candidates (45 found) but no clear stimulus-locked epoch table with both onset times and a behavioral-report trigger required for the Pass-35 e34-A §3.1 hypothesis (stimulus -> LCC -> P3b -> report). details.upgraded_reason: DANDI:000003 YutaMouse session DOES contain stimulus events: 45 candidates found, including 17 PulseStim_*V_*ms_* TimeSeries (electrical-pulse stimuli with onset timestamps and amplitude data). However: (a) these are sensory/electrical-stim epochs in rodent hippocampal LFP, not cognitive-task stimuli with conscious-report triggers (the Pass-35 §3.1 hypothesis requires stimulus -> LCC -> P3b -> *conscious report* sequence); (b) no behavioral-report dataset accompanies the PulseStim epochs in this session; (c) per Pass-35 §3.3 caveat, rodent-LFP P3b-analog cross-species mapping is explicitly noted as contested. Per pre-registered ladder + #69, INELIGIBLE stands. e36-D RAISED with two explicit Pass-37 paths: (i) human-EEG OpenNeuro ds002336 / ds003020 visual-oddball P3b paradigm (clean LCC vs P3b test); (ii) rodent-LFP secondary analysis as PARTIAL-EVIDENCE, explicitly framed as cross-species sensitivity check NOT primary test.
